actions.text: Pressing the iCal link toolbar item opens a Calendar Feed dialog with options for unmonitored, season premieres only, all-day events and tags, and a generated feed URL with copy and webcal buttons.
Pressing RSS Sync runs the RssSync command; the button spins while it is queued or started.
Pressing Search for Missing runs an episode search for the missing episode IDs in range.

Pressing Options opens the Calendar Options dialog with local options (collapse multiple episodes, cover art, episode information, finale/special/cutoff icons, full color events) and global settings (first day of week, week column header, time format, color impaired mode).
Changing a global setting in the options dialog saves it immediately as a UI setting.
Choosing a filter sets the selected calendar filter; custom filters of type calendar are listed.
Users can go to the previous or next range, jump to today, pick a date, or change the view from the header.
Swiping horizontally by more than 100 px moves to the previous or next range.
Pressing an event opens the episode details dialog.
A collapsed group of episodes can be expanded and collapsed.
The calendar loads episodes for the visible date range.

rules.text: The number of days shown is the page width divided by the minimum day width, clamped between 3 and 7.
Missing episodes for search are those with no file, aired within the visible range and already in the past, and not in the download queue.
The Search for Missing button is disabled when there are no missing episodes.
Repeating the same command within 5 seconds is ignored.
The unmonitored and includeSpecials filters default to true; a tags filter limits episodes by tag. These are sent with the date range to the calendar request.

Date range: Day view is one day; Week is the week by first day of week; Forecast starts yesterday and spans the day count; Month covers the full weeks of the month; Agenda runs from yesterday to one month ahead.
Fetched range is widened by 1 day in Day view and 1 week each side in Week and Forecast views.
Previous/next moves by the day count in Forecast view, otherwise by one view unit. Agenda view disables navigation and date picker.
The calendar jumps back to today on a repeating timer, and on opening unless the page was reached by back/forward navigation.
With collapse multiple episodes on, a day's episodes of the same series and season are grouped, and days are sorted by air time.

shows.text: The page is titled "Calendar" and has a toolbar with iCal link, RSS sync, search for missing, options and a filter menu.
When the library has no series, the calendar is replaced by a message to import or add series, with buttons "Import Existing Series" (/add/import) and "Add New Series" (/add/new).
The legend is shown below the calendar only when series exist.
The filter menu is disabled when there are no series.
While calendar data loads, a loading indicator shows; if loading fails, a danger alert shows "CalendarLoadError" text.
The calendar header shows previous/next arrows, a Today link, a go-to-date picker, a title and view switchers for Month, Week, Forecast, Day and Agenda; a loading indicator appears while fetching.
The header title is the long date in Day view, month and year in Month view, "Agenda" in Agenda view, and a start — end date range in other views.
On large screens the view choices are in a dropdown menu; the Month option is hidden on small screens. Otherwise each view is a separate button.
Non-agenda views show a row of day-of-week headers and a grid of days; in Month view the header shows the first 7 dates.
Agenda view lists episodes in order with a long-date heading whenever the day changes.
Each day cell lists that day's episodes; in Day view with none it shows "NoEpisodesAiring" text. Month view cells show the day number.

Each event shows series title, episode title and season x episode number (when episode information is on), and air time range; status icons show for warnings, downloading, premiere, finale, special and cutoff not met.
Agenda events can also show series cover art when that option is on.
An event's status is downloaded, downloading, unmonitored, onAir, missing or unaired.
The legend lists Unaired, Unmonitored, On Air, Missing, Downloading, Downloaded and Premiere, plus Season Finale/Series Finale, Special and Cutoff Not Met entries depending on options.

sideEffects.text: Pressing RSS Sync or Search for Missing sends a command to the server (POST /command).
Changing a global option saves UI settings to the server (PUT).
The calendar refetches when episode files are updated or deleted, and when a series refresh finishes.
Episode files for the visible episodes are requested from the episode file endpoint.
